To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the post-processing SIRS for STBC with unequal-power co-channel MIMO interference under path loss and Ray-leigh fading is approximately lognormal distributed.
the postprocessing SIR of the desired user is affected by both path loss and fading.
the post-processing SIRS of the STBC transmission with unequal-power MIMO interferers are not independent, and the post-processing SRSs of the STBC with equal-power MIMO interferes are independent.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a realistic scenario, and provides a useful reference for the system design.
the performance of the downlink STBC transmission under the presence of unequal-power co-channel MIMO interference.
the impact of unequal-power co-channel interferers on the downlink STBC transmission, which is of importance for the design and optimization of MIMO systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

, when the path loss and Rayless fading are considered, the post-processing SIRSs of the STBC transmission with different co- channel MIMO interferers are statistically independent, and they follow the exponential distribution.

, when the path loss exponent and the number of transmit antennas of the co-channel MIMO transmitter are both large, the performance of STBC transmission is not affected by the existence of the unequal-power interferers.
, for a given STBC transmission with unequal-power co-channel interferers, the post-processing SIC SIRs have a noncentral chi-square distribution.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

, for the STBC with unequal-power co-channel MIMO interference under path loss and Ray- liegh fading, the analytical results for the post-processing SIRSs can be obtained, which can be used as a reference for system design.

, when the path loss is taken into account, the post-processing SIC-SIRs of STBC with unequal-power co-channel MIMO interfering signals are not independent, and the statistical distributions of them can be derived.
the performance of STBC with unequal-power MIMO interferers under path loss and Ray-leigh fading is quite different from that of the case with only Rayleigh fading.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, for a given MIMO configuration, there is a trade-off between the performance of the desired signal and that of the co-channel MIMO interference.
the path loss and Ray- leigh fading have significant effects on the performance of STBC, and the performance of ST BC is sensitive to the unequal-power interferers.
the performance of STBC with unequal-power interferers can be significantly improved by increasing the power of the useful signal and by decreasing the path loss exponent.
